posts.community: Highness Microelectronics Ltd: a SMILE-type opportunity in electronics manufacturing?
posts.text: Highness - Update from Bharat Connect conference I attended the management session on 30 September. This was the clearest explanation of the business I have heard from them so far. Sharing the main updates and my observations below. Gaurav came across as competent, sincere and well prepared. He explained the products, manufacturing processes and customer requirements in detail. I felt he knows his business very well, though actual walk the talk history still need to be established. 1.
